equipment: Current-limited programmable supply in place of battery for initial evaluation
Oscilloscope recording BAT input current, SD_V3 atU11, V3V3 and SD_EN
Known data writer/readback comparison and firmware loss/error counters
first_stage: Use bench supply before connecting unqualified cell; if50mA input limit causes rail collapse, candidate fails this screen. Do not use current limit as proof of actual cell behavior.

conditions.temperature: Begin room temperature; operating corners only after permissible battery/system range is confirmed
operations: Cold boot from discharged switched rail
Sequential write sustained and alternating busy/idle
Minimum free-space writes after filling media

acceptance.battery_current: Stay within confirmed vendor continuous/pulse envelope; until clarified use50mA as provisional ceiling, including startup
acceptance.storage_rail: U11 supply remains within datasheet2.7..3.6V; scope at pins with sufficient bandwidth; no undershoot/overshoot outside limits
acceptance.ramp: Monotonic and meets storage vendor power-on/reset specification; missing vendor spec prevents qualification
acceptance.integrity: No byte mismatches or recording queue overruns; reset/brownout/data errors are failures
acceptance.time: Continuous16h recording still requires real pack run and energy integration; this test does not replace it

unresolved_before_release: JLC shortages and full landed quotation
